heroTitleHtml: Apps for your health, your business and your downtime, made honestly
heroLede: ECONTEUR LLC makes RAIMZEAL, RaimCalls, Raimovia, V3EDGE and more: AI tools and games with real free plans, clear prices and no Chinese AI models. Every page tells you exactly where each app is available today.
productsLede: Every product here is created and designed by ECONTEUR LLC. Filter by what you need; each page shows what's free, what it costs and where you can get it today.
aboutText: ECONTEUR LLC was founded on 11 November 2011 by Dr. Ephraim Oviawe, who worked in caregiving and healthcare services before he wrote software. He saw that the people who most need help are often priced out of the tools that offer it. So ECONTEUR builds products with real free plans, plain prices and honest limits, and paid tiers exist to keep the free ones free.
roadmapLede: Apps waiting for store review, products in development and features we're building. We add a date only when it's certain.
seoTitle: ECONTEUR LLC: AI Apps for Health, Business, Creating & Play
seoDescription: ECONTEUR LLC makes RAIMZEAL, RaimCalls, Raimovia, V3EDGE, GetIntoStores, RAIMFUN and more: AI apps and games with real free plans and no Chinese AI.

facts.label: products, live and in the works
the year ECONTEUR LLC was founded

values.d: RAIMZEAL's Foundation plan is free forever, not a trial, and RAIMFUN has no ads or purchases at all. Paid plans pay for the free ones.
No ECONTEUR product uses a Chinese AI model. Our AI features run on providers such as OpenAI.
Every app has a privacy policy and a clear way to delete your data. SparkReset keeps your history on your device.
We compare our apps with the best-known alternatives, cite our sources, and say where others are stronger.
Layouts are designed and checked on iPad and Android tablets, not just phones.
Dr. Ephraim Oviawe leads every product. Questions go to developer@econteur.com.

faq.q: Who makes RAIMZEAL, V3EDGE, RaimCalls and Raimovia?
faq.a: ECONTEUR LLC, a software company founded on 11 November 2011 by Dr. Ephraim Oviawe. Every product on this site, including GetIntoStores, RAIMFUN, RaimAction and SparkReset, is created and designed by ECONTEUR LLC.

faq.q: Which ECONTEUR apps are free?
faq.a: RAIMZEAL's Foundation plan is free forever. RAIMFUN is free with no ads or purchases. V3EDGE is free with no paid plans today. RaimAction has 35 free operations and optional packs, and SparkReset has a free version with optional Premium. RaimCalls and Raimovia are paid business tools; Raimovia starts with a 7-day trial.

faq.q: Do ECONTEUR apps use Chinese AI?
faq.a: No. No ECONTEUR product uses a Chinese AI model. Our AI features run on providers such as OpenAI, and apps like RaimCalls and V3EDGE ask for your consent before using them.

faq.q: Is the RAIMZEAL Health Foundation a charity?
faq.a: RAIMZEAL Health Foundation, Inc. is a Georgia nonprofit corporation. It is not a registered charity and not a 501(c)(3): its application for federal tax exemption was filed in September 2026 and has not been granted. Donations to it are not tax-deductible.

faq.q: When is V3EDGE coming to iPhone and Android?
faq.a: There's no date yet. The iPhone, iPad and Android apps are in progress, and we won't announce a date until they're approved. Today, V3EDGE works free in your browser at v3edge.app/app.

faq.q: How do I delete my data?
faq.a: Open the app's Delete your data page from Privacy, terms & support, or email developer@econteur.com from the address on your account. Apps that keep data only on your device, such as SparkReset, are cleared when you delete the app.

faq.q: Which ECONTEUR apps are on iPhone today?
faq.a: RAIMZEAL is live on the App Store. RaimCalls, GetIntoStores, RAIMFUN, RaimAction and SparkReset are waiting for App Store review, and all of them are already live on Google Play.

faq.q: Is RAIMZEAL medical advice?
faq.a: No. RAIMZEAL is a wellness app. It doesn't diagnose or treat anything; for medical questions, talk to a qualified health professional.

faq.q: What's the difference between RaimCalls and Raimovia?
faq.a: RaimCalls is the phone app: it makes calls for you and answers your business line. Raimovia is the web platform for the rest of your business: inbox, CRM, bookings, payments and automations. Raimovia itself doesn't handle phone calls.

faq.q: Do ECONTEUR games have ads or loot boxes?
faq.a: No. RAIMFUN, RaimAction and SparkReset contain no ads, and RaimAction has no loot boxes.

faq.q: How do I contact ECONTEUR?
faq.a: Email developer@econteur.com.

llmsNotes: Founder Dr. Ephraim Oviawe holds a PhD; he is not a medical doctor. RAIMZEAL is a wellness app and does not give medical advice.
RAIMZEAL Health Foundation, Inc. is a Georgia nonprofit corporation, not a registered charity or 501(c)(3); donations to it are not tax-deductible.

V3EDGE is web-only today; its iPhone, iPad and Android apps have no release date.

products.name: RAIMZEAL
products.tagline: A free-forever AI health coach for food, workouts, sleep and women's health, all in one app.
products.summary: RAIMZEAL brings nutrition, workouts, sleep, mindfulness and women's health tracking together with Ovia AI, a coach you can chat with every day. The Foundation plan is free forever: it is the product, not a trial.
products.who: For anyone who wants one place to eat better, move more and understand their body, without paying for four separate apps.

features.t: Ovia AI chat, free every day
features.d: Ask Ovia AI about meals, training, sleep or your cycle. The free plan includes 10 chats a day; paid plans include more.
Scan a barcode to log calories and macros in seconds. No upgrade needed.
Follow guided workouts at no cost. The AI Workout Generator, which builds sessions around you, comes with Rise.
Period tracking, cycle sync, PCOS, pregnancy and menopause modes are all part of the free Foundation plan.
Track sleep, hydration and fasting windows, and take a breathing or mindfulness break when you need one.
One short lesson a day to help healthy habits stick.
Join challenges and keep each other going.
RAIMZEAL comes with a companion app for Apple Watch.
Photograph your plate for an AI estimate of calories and macros. Part of Rise, $9.99 a month.

features.t: Talk to Ovia AI out loud (Reign)
features.d: Real-time voice conversation with your coach: 90 minutes a month on Reign ($19.99/month) or 240 on Legacy ($49.99/month).

notes: RAIMZEAL is a wellness app. It does not give medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. For medical questions, talk to a qualified health professional.

Paid plans: Rise $9.99/month or $99/year, Reign $19.99/month or $199/year, Legacy $49.99/month or $499/year. Voice conversation and AI meal-photo scanning are paid features; daily Ovia AI chat is free.
howto: Download RAIMZEAL from the App Store or Google Play, or open raimzeal.com in your browser.
Create your free account and tell Ovia AI what you want to work on.
Use the free Foundation plan for as long as you like. Upgrade only if you want voice coaching or the AI meal scanner.
products.seoTitle: RAIMZEAL: Free AI Health Coach for Fitness & Nutrition
products.seoDescription: RAIMZEAL is a free-forever AI health coach: daily Ovia AI chat, barcode macros, workouts and women's health tracking on iPhone, Android and web.

faq.q: Is RAIMZEAL really free?
faq.a: Yes. The Foundation plan is free forever, not a trial. It includes daily Ovia AI chat (10 a day), barcode macro tracking, workouts, women's health trackers, sleep, hydration, fasting and mindfulness tools, the daily lesson and community challenges.

faq.q: What do the paid plans add?
faq.a: Rise ($9.99/month) adds the AI meal scanner, the AI Workout Generator and more chat. Reign ($19.99/month) adds real-time voice conversation with Ovia AI, 90 minutes a month. Legacy ($49.99/month) raises voice to 240 minutes a month.

faq.q: Is there a free MyFitnessPal alternative with barcode scanning?
faq.a: Yes. RAIMZEAL's free Foundation plan scans barcodes, and so does Cronometer's free tier. MyFitnessPal lists barcode scanning as a Premium feature.

faq.q: What app tracks workouts, food and my period in one place?
faq.a: RAIMZEAL does all three on its free plan, including PCOS, pregnancy and menopause modes. Google Health Premium also combines them, at $9.99 a month.

faq.q: Can I talk to an AI fitness coach out loud?
faq.a: Yes. RAIMZEAL's Reign plan ($19.99/month) includes real-time voice conversation with Ovia AI, 90 minutes a month.

faq.q: What is a free alternative to Fitbod?
faq.a: Fitbod has no permanent free tier; its App Store price is $15.99 a month. RAIMZEAL's free plan includes guided workouts, and its AI Workout Generator is part of Rise ($9.99/month).

faq.q: Is RAIMZEAL a medical app?
faq.a: No. RAIMZEAL is a wellness coach. It does not diagnose or treat any condition, and it is not a substitute for a qualified health professional.

faq.q: Who makes RAIMZEAL?
faq.a: RAIMZEAL is created and designed by ECONTEUR LLC, founded in 2011 by Dr. Ephraim Oviawe.

compare.blurb: Food, workouts, women's health and AI chat on one free plan, next to the eight best-known health apps.

rows.feature: Free plan with no time limit
Live voice conversation with the coach

advantages.t: One free plan covers nearly everything
advantages.d: Nutrition, workouts, women's health and daily AI chat sit on a plan that is free forever. Flo covers cycles but not fitness, Fitbod covers workouts but not food, and the calorie trackers don't track cycles.
MyFitnessPal and Lose It! put barcode scanning behind Premium. On RAIMZEAL it is part of the free plan.
Fitness, nutrition and cycle tracking work together in one app on your phone, tablet or browser. Google's coach launched first for Fitbit and Pixel Watch owners.

honest.d: MyFitnessPal, WeightWatchers and Flo each show around two million or more App Store ratings. RAIMZEAL is new and has no public rating yet.
WeightWatchers and Noom offer GLP-1 programs and human coaching, and Google's coach can read US medical records. RAIMZEAL is a wellness coach and does not provide medical care.

products.name: RaimCalls
products.tagline: AI that calls and texts for you: it waits on hold, cancels plans and answers your business line 24/7.
products.summary: RaimCalls makes the calls you keep putting off. It works the phone menu, waits on hold for up to 45 minutes, and cancels, books or chases things for you. For your business, it answers your line day and night and books callers into your real calendar.
products.who: For busy people who hate phone queues, and for small-business owners who can't pick up every call.

features.d: Say what you need: cancel a plan, chase an order, ask for a better price or make a booking. RaimCalls places the call, works the phone menu and waits on hold for up to 45 minutes.
It tells the other side it is an AI, never shares passwords or card numbers, and never agrees to pay for anything.
Eve or Adam picks up day and night, using your own services, prices and hours.
Callers are booked straight into your calendar, not into a separate list you have to copy over.
RaimCalls writes the text; nothing is sent until you tap Send. It only texts people who have agreed to hear from you.
Ask questions, keep to-dos and check your calendar in the same app.
Keep track of bills and subscriptions, log expenses and export them as PDF or CSV.
Calls to your own clients need their consent, happen only between 8am and 9pm their time, and STOP is always honoured.
Paid plans come with a business phone number.

notes: RaimCalls uses OpenAI for speech and understanding. The in-app consent screen names the provider before you start.
Plans are monthly in-app subscriptions: Foundation $49, Rise $149, Reign $349 and Legacy $799. The iPhone app, which includes a 7-day Foundation trial, is waiting for App Store review.
howto: Install RaimCalls from Google Play. The iPhone app is waiting for App Store review.
Choose a plan and add your details: your services, prices and opening hours.
Tap Call for me and describe what you need, or switch on 24/7 answering for your business line.
products.seoTitle: RaimCalls: AI That Calls, Waits on Hold & Answers for You
products.seoDescription: RaimCalls is an AI phone assistant that waits on hold, cancels plans and makes bookings for you, and answers your business line 24/7. On Google Play.

faq.q: Is there an AI that waits on hold for you?
faq.a: Yes. RaimCalls' Call for me waits on hold for up to 45 minutes and handles the call when someone picks up. Google's Hold for Me also waits on hold, but only on Pixel phones in Australia, Canada, Japan, the UK and the US.

faq.q: Can AI call a business for me?
faq.a: Yes. Google Search can call some US local businesses to check prices and availability. RaimCalls goes further and handles tasks such as cancelling a plan, chasing an order or booking an appointment.

faq.q: Is there an AI that cancels subscriptions by phone?
faq.a: Yes. RaimCalls places cancellation calls for you. Pine AI also advertises cancellations and bill negotiation, from $99.9 a month billed annually.

faq.q: Does RaimCalls tell people it is an AI?
faq.a: Yes, on every call. It also never shares passwords or card numbers and never agrees to pay for anything on your behalf.

faq.q: What is the cheapest AI receptionist for a small business?
faq.a: Smith.ai has a free plan with 25 calls, and Rosie starts at $49 a month for 250 minutes. RaimCalls also starts at $49 a month and adds something they don't: it makes calls for you too.

faq.q: Is Ruby worth it versus an AI receptionist?
faq.a: Ruby uses live human receptionists, from $250 a month for 50 minutes. AI services such as Rosie, Goodcall or RaimCalls cost much less per minute, but they are not human.

faq.q: Does OpenPhone have an AI receptionist?
faq.a: Yes. OpenPhone is now called Quo, and its Sona agent answers calls 24/7, with 10 calls included and add-on tiers from $25 a month.

faq.q: Is RaimCalls on iPhone?
faq.a: Not yet. RaimCalls is live on Google Play, and the iPhone app is waiting for App Store review.

compare.blurb: The only one here that both makes calls for you and answers your business line.

advantages.d: RaimCalls makes calls for you and answers your own line. Google and Pine only call out; the receptionist services only answer.

advantages.t: Hold for Me without a Pixel
advantages.d: Google's Hold for Me needs a Pixel phone in one of five countries. RaimCalls waits on hold from its own app, on Android today and on iPhone once it is approved.

advantages.t: Your admin in the same place
advantages.d: Bills, subscriptions and expenses with PDF and CSV export live next to your calls. None of the receptionist services track these.

honest.d: Rosie includes 250 minutes for $49 a month and My AI Front Desk 200 minutes for $99. If you only need answering, they give you more minutes for the money, and Smith.ai and Google have free plans.
Smith.ai and Ruby can hand calls to live receptionists and offer legal-practice integrations, and Pine specialises in bill negotiation.

products.name: Raimovia
products.tagline: Run your business from one place: AI employees, inbox, CRM, bookings, payments and a weekly report.
products.summary: Raimovia is an AI business operating platform for small businesses. Role-based AI employees work from knowledge you approve, alongside a unified inbox, CRM, bookings, quotes, invoices and automations, and a weekly report tells you how the business is doing.
products.who: For owner-operators and small teams, such as consultants, studios and local services, who want one workspace instead of a stack of subscriptions.

features.d: Role-based AI assistants that answer from the knowledge you approve, so they stay on-message.
Answer visitors on your site and turn questions into leads.
Email, SMS and web chat in a single inbox.
See every contact and deal, and know which leads to call back first.
Share a booking page and let clients pick a time that suits you both.
Send a quote, turn it into an invoice and get paid in the same place.
Follow up automatically and run campaigns without extra tools.
A weekly summary of how your business is doing, delivered to you.

features.t: Knowledge base and Ask Ovia AI
features.d: Keep your answers in one place and ask Ovia AI about your business.
Collect reviews, give clients their own portal, and present it all under your brand.

notes: Raimovia does not answer or place phone calls. For AI phone calls, use RaimCalls, a separate ECONTEUR app.
Plans are billed monthly: Foundation $99, Rise $299 and Reign $799. Legacy ($2,499) is arranged directly. Foundation starts with a 7-day trial.
howto: Go to raimovia.com and start the 7-day Foundation trial, or install the Android app from Google Play.
Add your services, prices and approved knowledge so your AI employees answer accurately.
Connect your inbox and booking page, then let the weekly report show you what's working.
products.seoTitle: Raimovia: AI Business Platform for Small Businesses
products.seoDescription: Raimovia gives small businesses AI employees, a unified inbox, CRM, bookings, quotes, invoices, automations and a weekly owner report in one place.

faq.q: Is Raimovia a HubSpot alternative for small businesses?
faq.a: Yes, for owners who want leads, quotes, payments, bookings and follow-ups in one AI-assisted workspace. HubSpot has a free CRM for up to two users and a much larger ecosystem; Raimovia is narrower and built for owner-operators.

faq.q: Raimovia or GoHighLevel: which is simpler?
faq.a: GoHighLevel is built for agencies, starting at $97 a month, and its AI Employee is a $50 to $97 add-on per sub-account. Raimovia is built for a single business, with AI employees included in the plan.

faq.q: Does Raimovia answer phone calls?
faq.a: No. Raimovia handles your inbox, CRM, bookings, payments, automations and reports. Phone calls are handled by RaimCalls, a separate ECONTEUR app.

faq.q: Can Raimovia send quotes and take payments?
faq.a: Yes. Quotes, invoices and payments are part of every plan's core workflow.

faq.q: Is there a Raimovia iPhone app?
faq.a: Not on the App Store today. Raimovia runs in any browser at raimovia.com, and there is an Android app on Google Play.

faq.q: Does Raimovia send a weekly business report?
faq.a: Yes. Owners receive a weekly report summarising how the business is doing. None of the competitor pricing pages we reviewed list an equivalent.

faq.q: Raimovia or Jobber for a business that isn't a trade?
faq.a: Jobber is designed for home-service trades with crews and dispatch. Raimovia is general-purpose, so it suits consultants, studios and local services that don't send out crews.

faq.q: How much does Raimovia cost?
faq.a: Foundation is $99 a month with a 7-day trial, Rise is $299 and Reign is $799. Legacy, at $2,499 a month, is arranged directly.

compare.blurb: AI employees, CRM, bookings, payments and a weekly report in one workspace, next to eight small-business platforms.

advantages.t: One AI layer across the whole loop
advantages.d: Lead, quote, payment, booking and follow-up run in one place with AI employees included, instead of a $97 platform plus a $50 to $97 AI add-on per sub-account on GoHighLevel.

advantages.t: A weekly report on your business
advantages.d: None of the competitor pricing pages we checked advertise one.
Jobber and Housecall Pro are built around field-service dispatch. Raimovia works for any service business.

honest.d: HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Bigin, Jobber, Housecall Pro and Pipedrive all have iPhone apps. Raimovia is on the web and Android today.
HubSpot and Bigin offer free plans with large integration ecosystems, and Bigin's paid plan starts at $7 per user a month.

products.name: V3EDGE

statusNote.iOS: iPhone and iPad app in progress, date not set

Key out a green background for a clean composite.
Trim, split, change speed from 0.25x to 4x, and crop to 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9.
Enough to give every edit its own look, all included.
Generate captions or on-screen lyrics automatically, then tweak them.
Translate your captions into 26 languages.
Add a narrated voice-over without recording one yourself.

Describe a change, such as a new background, location or outfit, adding or removing something, or new lighting, on clips up to 60 seconds. V3EDGE asks your permission before sending a clip to an AI provider.
No paid plans, no in-app purchases and no watermark on your exports.

coming.d: The full editor on Apple devices, with rendering on the device.
The full editor on Android phones and tablets.

howto: Open v3edge.app/app in your browser.
Import a clip, then remove the background in one tap or start cutting on the timeline.
Add captions, transitions or an AI Edit, and export free, with no watermark.
products.seoTitle: V3EDGE: Free Video Editor with AI Background Removal
products.seoDescription: V3EDGE is a free video editor with one-tap background removal, auto-captions in 26 languages, AI Edit and no watermark. Use it in your browser today.

faq.q: Is V3EDGE free?
faq.a: Yes. V3EDGE is free to use today, with no paid plans, no in-app purchases and no watermark.

faq.q: When is V3EDGE coming to iPhone and Android?
faq.a: There is no date yet. The iPhone, iPad and Android apps are in progress, and we will only announce a date once they are actually approved. Until then, the full editor works in your browser at v3edge.app/app.

faq.q: What is a good CapCut alternative without Chinese AI?
faq.a: Adobe Premiere mobile and Edits by Instagram are free, US-owned and available now. V3EDGE uses only non-Chinese AI providers and asks before sending any clip; it runs in the browser today, with mobile apps coming.

faq.q: What is the best free video editor with no watermark?
faq.a: Adobe Premiere mobile and Edits both export without a watermark for free. V3EDGE is also free with no watermark and no paid plans.

faq.q: How do I remove a video background for free?
faq.a: In V3EDGE, open your clip and tap background removal; then fill the background with a colour, a blur or a photo. CapCut, InShot, VN, Premiere and Edits also offer one-tap cut-out.

faq.q: Is there an AI that changes my outfit or lighting in a video?
faq.a: Yes. V3EDGE's AI Edit takes a typed request, such as a new background, outfit or lighting, on clips up to 60 seconds. Premiere offers Firefly Generative Fill, but its listing does not describe outfit changes.

faq.q: What is a cheaper alternative to the Captions app?
faq.a: Captions' first paid tier is $24.99 a month. Free auto-caption options include V3EDGE, Premiere mobile, Edits and VN, though only Captions advertises 100+ caption languages.

compare.blurb: Free with no watermark, generative AI edits and non-Chinese AI, next to the eight best-known editors.

rows.feature: Not owned by a Chinese company

advantages.d: No paid plans and no in-app purchases today. CapCut Pro is $19.99 a month and Captions Max is $24.99.

advantages.t: Generative edits on a real timeline
advantages.d: Change the outfit, lighting or background in the same app where you trim and caption. Most editors here stop at cut-out and captions.
V3EDGE uses only non-Chinese AI providers and asks before sending a clip. CapCut's App Store seller is Bytedance Pte. Ltd.

honest.d: All eight are live now, most with large numbers of ratings. V3EDGE's mobile apps are not released yet.
LumaFusion and Premiere offer pro timelines and 4K/HDR export, Captions supports 100+ caption languages to V3EDGE's 26, and CapCut's template library is far larger.

products.seoTitle: GetIntoStores: DRM-Free Ebooks Direct from Creators
products.seoDescription: Buy DRM-free ebooks straight from independent creators on GetIntoStores. 45 ebooks by Dr. Ephraim Oviawe from $6.69, each with a free sample.

faq.q: Why buy from GetIntoStores instead of Amazon?
faq.a: You buy directly from the creator, the files are DRM-free, and every book has a free sample. Amazon offers far more reach and Kindle Unlimited, and pays authors a 70% royalty only on ebooks priced $2.99 to $12.99.

faq.q: How much are the ebooks?
faq.a: The 45 ebooks by Dr. Ephraim Oviawe cost $6.69, $8.89, $9.99 or $10.99. Discount codes and web bundles can lower the price.

faq.q: Can I read a sample first?
faq.a: Yes. Every one of the 45 ebooks has a free sample.

faq.q: Can I gift an ebook?
faq.a: Yes, on getintostores.com. Gifts and bundles aren't available inside the iPhone or Android apps.

faq.q: What formats can I read?
faq.a: The built-in readers handle PDF and EPUB, and play audio and video products.

faq.q: Can I sell my own books on GetIntoStores?
faq.a: Yes. Creators get a storefront and seller workflow, with discount codes and affiliates. GetIntoStores keeps a 10% commission on each sale.

faq.q: GetIntoStores or Gumroad for creators?
faq.a: Gumroad charges 10% plus $0.50 per direct sale and 30% on sales through its Discover marketplace. GetIntoStores keeps 10% and includes built-in readers for your buyers.

compare.blurb: Buy direct from creators, DRM-free, with readers built in, next to the big ebook stores and creator platforms.

rows.feature: Platform's cut on an ebook sale

advantages.d: Your money goes to the creator through their own storefront, and the file isn't locked to one device.
Discount codes, affiliates, reviews, and gifts and bundles on the web, without stitching together Shopify apps.
Buyers read PDF and EPUB, and play audio and video, inside GetIntoStores instead of juggling files.

honest.d: Amazon, Apple, Google and Kobo bring millions of existing buyers, plus subscription programmes such as Kindle Unlimited and Kobo Plus.
Gumroad acts as merchant of record for tax, and Payhip handles EU and UK VAT and offers PDF stamping and download limits.
